items.name: combobox-001
items.title: Поле с фильтрацией
items.description: Базовый combobox: кнопка показывает выбранное, панель открывает поле фильтра и список, значение берётся только из списка.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, собственная палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-combobox-001-*. Клиентский: useState держит значение, запрос, открытость и индекс курсора, useEffect переводит фокус в поле фильтра при открытии. Кнопка-триггер несёт aria-haspopup="listbox" и aria-expanded, поле внутри панели — role="combobox", aria-controls и aria-activedescendant, список — role="listbox" со строками role="option" и aria-selected. Клавиатура: стрелки ведут курсор по кругу, Home и End прыгают на края, Enter выбирает, Escape закрывает панель и возвращает фокус на кнопку. Панель лежит в потоке, а не поверх: всплывающий слой в узкой колонке нечем позиционировать без замера. Выбор мышью идёт по onMouseDown с preventDefault, чтобы поле не потеряло фокус раньше выбора.

<Combobox001
  label="Статус задачи"
  placeholder="Выберите статус"
  options={["Активен", "В работе", "Завершён"]}
  onSelect={(value) => console.log(value)}
/>

en.description: A basic combobox: the trigger shows the selection, the panel holds a filter field and the list, and the value can only come from the list.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in the local --vibeui-combobox-001-* variables. Client component: useState holds the value, the query, the open state and the cursor index, and useEffect moves focus into the filter field on opening. The trigger button carries aria-haspopup="listbox" and aria-expanded, the field inside the panel is a role="combobox" with aria-controls and aria-activedescendant, and the list is a role="listbox" with role="option" rows and aria-selected. Keyboard: the arrows move the cursor in a loop, Home and End jump to the edges, Enter selects, Escape closes the panel and returns focus to the button. The panel lies in the flow rather than on top: a floating layer in a narrow column has nothing to position it against without measurement. Mouse selection goes through onMouseDown with preventDefault, so that the field does not lose focus before the selection.

ai.summary: A combobox with a filter and full keyboard support: the value is picked from a known list and the filter text never becomes the value. One file, zero dependencies, client component.

returning focus to the trigger on Escape — otherwise focus jumps to the top of the page when the panel closes
onMouseDown with preventDefault on the rows: onClick fires after blur and the mouse selection is lost
light-dark() in the palette: the component has to follow the surrounding color-scheme rather than ship a dark theme of its own
the transparent background by default — the component sits on the page background instead of laying a panel under itself

notes: The theme comes from color-scheme. For the component to darken with the system, the project must declare color-scheme: light dark on html — otherwise light-dark() always returns the light branch.

An unbounded list hits max-height and scrolling — for hundreds of rows take the windowed variant.

items.name: combobox-002
items.title: Сгруппированные разделы
items.description: Combobox с разделами: заголовки групп подписывают строки, пустые группы при фильтрации исчезают, а стрелки идут насквозь мимо заголовков.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, собственная палитра --vibeui-combobox-002-*. Клиентский: useState держит запрос, значение и индекс курсора, useMemo пересобирает группы и плоский порядок строк. Разметка вложенная: внешний ul с role="listbox", внутри li role="presentation" с ul role="group" и aria-labelledby на заголовок. Заголовок группы — li role="presentation", поэтому он не попадает в счёт строк и стрелки через него перепрыгивают; нумерация option'ов сквозная, на ней держится aria-activedescendant. Счётчик у заголовка показывает, сколько строк осталось в разделе после фильтра. Группа без совпадений выбрасывается целиком: пустой заголовок вводит в заблуждение сильнее, чем его отсутствие.

  placeholder="Найти раздел"
  groups={[{ label: "Продажи", options: ["Новая сделка", "Список клиентов"] }]}
  onSelect={(value) => console.log(value)}
/>
ai.summary: Combobox с группами и заголовками разделов: заголовки не мешают клавиатуре, пустые группы скрываются, у каждой группы счётчик совпадений. Один файл, ноль зависимостей.

en.description: A combobox with sections: group headings label the rows, empty groups disappear while filtering, and the arrow keys step straight past the headings.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own --vibeui-combobox-002-* palette. Client component: useState holds the query, the value and the cursor index, and useMemo rebuilds the groups and the flat row order. The markup is nested: an outer ul with role="listbox", inside it li elements with role="presentation" holding a ul with role="group" and an aria-labelledby pointing at the heading. A group heading is an li with role="presentation", so it does not count towards the rows and the arrows jump over it; the option numbering is continuous and aria-activedescendant rests on it. The counter beside a heading shows how many rows are left in the section after filtering. A group with no matches is dropped entirely: an empty heading misleads more than its absence.

role="presentation" on the group heading — a heading with the option role breaks both the arrows and the "row N of M" count
aria-labelledby on ul role="group": that is what makes the section announced on entry
hiding empty groups: a heading with no rows reads as a broken filter
light-dark() in the palette: the component has to follow the surrounding color-scheme rather than ship a dark theme of its own
the transparent background by default — the component sits on the page background instead of laying a panel under itself

the field caption through label and the empty text through placeholder
the empty-result text through emptyLabel
the accent color through accent and the width through max-width
background — the component surface; empty means no surface, taking the page colour
notes: The theme comes from color-scheme. For the component to darken with the system, the project must declare color-scheme: light dark on html — otherwise light-dark() always returns the light branch.
Headings are not sticky: for long sections add position:sticky to [data-part="grouplabel"].
A group's key comes from its caption — two groups with the same name collide on the heading id.
Enter picks the row under the cursor, not the first row of a section: after filtering the cursor always sits on the first visible row.
Do not lift the CSS variables into globals.css: the component has to stay a single file.

  placeholder="Find a section"
  groups={[{ label: "Sales", options: ["New deal", "Client list"] }]}
  onSelect={(value) => console.log(value)}
/>

items.description: Множественный выбор фишками: отмеченное остаётся в списке с галочкой, счётчик держит лимит, Backspace в пустом поле снимает последнюю фишку.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, без зависимостей, собственная палитра --vibeui-combobox-003-*. Клиентский: useState держит массив выбранного, запрос и курсор. Список объявлен aria-multiselectable="true", каждая строка несёт aria-selected по факту выбора и рисует свой квадратик-отметку.   defaultSelected={["Дизайн"]}

en.description: Multi-select with chips: a picked row stays in the list with a check mark, a counter holds the limit, and Backspace in an empty field drops the last chip.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own --vibeui-combobox-003-* palette. Client component: useState holds the array of selected items, the query and the cursor. The list is declared aria-multiselectable="true", and every row carries aria-selected according to the actual selection and draws its own check mark. Unlike a tag picker, a selected item is not removed from the list: pressing it again clears the selection in the same place where it was made. The chips lie in a shared field with the input, and the focus ring is put on the field through :has(input:focus-visible). The maxSelected limit blocks further additions and hides the placeholder, and the counter in the header is declared aria-live="polite".

the separate button with aria-label on every chip: a bare cross does not say what it removes
light-dark() in the palette: the component has to follow the surrounding color-scheme rather than ship a dark theme of its own
the transparent background by default — the component sits on the page background instead of laying a panel under itself

en.description: A person picker: an initials avatar, a second line with the email and the role, and a search that runs over both lines at once.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own --vibeui-combobox-004-* palette. en.description: A “section then value” picker: sections on the left, their contents on the right, and the moment you type, both panes collapse into one cross-section list of matches.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, zero dependencies, its own palette in the local --vibeui-combobox-013-* variables. The left column is hidden with the hidden attribute rather than by unmounting, so the width does not twitch. ARIA: an input with role="combobox", the right column a role="listbox", the rows buttons with role="option" inside li role="none", so the keyboard works without managing activedescendant by hand.

items.description: Поиск, где совпадения отсортированы по релевантности, а найденный кусок подсвечен: начало строки идёт выше начала слова, а середина — в самом конце.
items.docs: Компонент самодостаточен: один файл, ноль зависимостей, собственная палитра в локальных переменных --vibeui-combobox-015-*. Клиентский: запрос и значение живут в useState. Ранжирование делает функция scoreOf: она возвращает ранг (0 — совпадение с начала строки, 1 — с начала слова, 2 — внутри слова) и позицию вхождения. Сортировка идёт по рангу, затем по позиции, затем по алфавиту — три ключа дают устойчивый порядок без дребезга при вводе. Подсветка не использует dangerouslySetInnerHTML: строка режется на три куска по индексу, средний оборачивается в семантический <mark>, поэтому подсветка переживает любой текст, включая символы разметки. Ранг подписан словами справа, чтобы порядок был объясним, а не магичен.

en.description: A search where matches are ordered by relevance and the matched fragment is highlighted: the start of a string outranks the start of a word, and mid-word matches come last.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, zero dependencies, its own palette in the local --vibeui-combobox-015-* variables. Client component: the query and the value live in useState. The ranking is done by the scoreOf function: it returns a rank (0 for a match at the start of the string, 1 at the start of a word, 2 inside a word) and the position of the occurrence. The sort goes by rank, then by position, then alphabetically — three keys give a stable order with no jitter while typing. The highlighting does not use dangerouslySetInnerHTML: the string is cut into three pieces by index and the middle one is wrapped in a semantic <mark>, so the highlighting survives any text, including markup characters. The rank is labelled in words on the right, so that the order is explainable rather than magical.

en.description: A picker with an asynchronous check: after a click the status line goes into “checking”, then answers with the stock left or a refusal with a reason.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, zero dependencies, its own palette in the local --vibeui-combobox-018-* variables. Client component: the query, the value and the check state live in useState. The check is moved into a useEffect with a cleanup function: the timer is cancelled on every change of the value, so when options are switched quickly the last selection wins rather than the last answer to arrive — this cures the classic race. The check state is one of four values (idle, checking, ok, bad) and is raised as a data-state attribute, so the colour of the status line is set by CSS rather than by branching styles in JSX. The spinner is assembled from a border with a rotation animation and is switched off by a prefers-reduced-motion rule. The status line is linked to the field through aria-describedby and announced through aria-live.

ai.summary: A picker where the chosen value still has to be verified on the server: is there stock, is the domain free, is the licence valid. A click moves the status line into “checking”, and the answer arrives as a number or a refusal. The response race is handled by clearing the timer in the effect: rapid switching lets the last selection win. Zero dependencies, one file, its own palette.

Клиентский: useState держит список недавних, запрос, значение и курсор, useMemo собирает две группы и общий плоский порядок. Выбранное значение уходит в начало недавних и подрезается по recentLimit; из общего блока оно исключается, чтобы одна строка не встречалась дважды и не ломала счёт стрелками. Вместо подписанных секций между группами стоит li role="separator" aria-orientation="horizontal" — тонкая линия без текста; у самой недавней строки вместо иконки — компактная текстовая метка recentTag. Разделитель рендерится, только если обе группы непустые, поэтому при пустом запросе и без недавних он не появляется зря.

en.description: A combobox with recent values and no section headings: a thin role="separator" line sets them apart from the rest, and every recent row carries a "recent" tag.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own --vibeui-combobox-022-* palette. Client component: useState holds the list of recent values, the query, the value and the cursor, and useMemo assembles the two groups and the shared flat order. The separator is rendered only when both groups are non-empty, so with an empty query and no recent values it does not appear for nothing.

en.description: A search that highlights every occurrence of the query in a row, not just the first one; the row order never changes — this is a highlighted filter, not ranking.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, zero dependencies, its own palette in the local --vibeui-combobox-023-* variables. Client component: the query and the value live in useState. en.description: Multi-select with collapsing chips: beyond the limit, selected values hide behind a "+N" button that expands and collapses the full row itself.
en.docs: The component is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own --vibeui-combobox-024-* palette.
